runtime_audit.scope: Read-only batch audit; no installation, compiler selection, path save or MATLAB configuration change.

protocol: Unmodified downloaded functions, invisible figures, default stopping rules. Objectives are pre-update values printed to four decimals, not fresh final-design solves.

isolated_validation_tools.compiler: WinLibs GCC 14.2.0 x86_64 POSIX SEH UCRT, release 3
isolated_validation_tools.isolation: MW_MINGW64_LOC and MATLAB_PREFDIR set only in child process; preferences under matlab-prefs-R2026a; no global PATH, saved MATLAB path or normal compiler setup changed.
isolated_validation_tools.assembly_checks: Three seeded random duplicate-index matrices and one exact fixture agree with MATLAB sparse to 1e-12.
isolated_validation_tools.image_toolbox: Licensed but absent. Owner approved toolbox-only R2026aU5 addition, then chose to install it personally after Windows elevation/write-access failure. Waiting for owner; no toolbox installed by this agent.

optimizer_reference.provenance: Identified GPL distribution copy of Svanberg's September 2007/August 2008 MMA with embedded subsolv, run unchanged in MATLAB; not a direct download from the now-unavailable author site. Source and COPYING retained outside this repository.
optimizer_reference.protocol: Minimize sum(w./x), w=[1,2,3,5,7,11], sum(x)<=2.4, bounds [0.05,1], x0=linspace(0.25,0.75,6), 30 outer mmasub calls with all native defaults, a0=1,a=0,c=1000,d=0; old1=old2=x0, low=xmin, upp=xmax. Fresh final objective. This checks mmapy's port, not equality of Toporia's distinct one-budget MMA variant.

Challis.message: Main source now downloads; the author's bwdist helper still returns an HTML challenge. Image Processing Toolbox bwdist/padarray are absent from the installation. No replacement helper installed or substituted.

TOPRBF.comparison_scope: Standalone original reference, not an equality oracle for Toporia's mean-normalised, guarded variant. A 24x8 attempt produced non-finite fields and an empty design and was rejected.

TOBS101.message: Option "CutGeneration" for intlinprog has been removed.

cases.name: top3d_density
cases.load_convention: One unit downward force on every tip-bottom depth node; the Python reference recipe explicitly uses uniform node shares, not the production trapezoidal line-load quadrature.
